source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Send command: ipmitool sensor list | grep -i power
Check power consumption data.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. power consumption data should be readable and correct.
2. The data should be the same as in BMC web UI

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool ... sensor list | grep -iE "power"; curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Chassis/1/Power | jq -r '.PowerControl[]'
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Return IPMI power sensor and Redfish Power JSON for user confirmation against WebUI.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES adds Redfish but guesses Chassis/1, disables TLS verification, exposes credentials and does not prove a CPU-specific metric or synchronized UI equality.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED adds sensor mapping, units, timestamps, endpoint discovery, transport safety and tolerance.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 986/2291 retained YES and generic user judgment without resolving CPU-versus-chassis semantics.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Row 988/00278 is a baseline-audited cap/stress case and remains a distinct state-changing objective; following set/max-cap cases must not be conflated with this read-only reading.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 preserves grep and UI wording; ED-36 treats mapping/tolerance as readiness, not permanent block; ED-38 keeps final verdict engineer-owned.

original_test_intent: Read CPU current power consumption and verify the value is readable, correct and consistent with the BMC WebUI.
original_method: Use the preserved IPMI power-sensor read, identify the actual CPU metric, and compare it with a synchronized WebUI observation using Project-approved units, sampling semantics and tolerance.
manual_activity: Engineer/operator confirms which sensor is CPU current power and compares synchronized normalized evidence with the WebUI according to the Project tolerance; this human/UI checkpoint prevents a fully automated classification.
required_inputs: CPU power sensor and WebUI field mapping
safety_requirements: Do not clear logs, change power limits or trigger power transitions.
Do not use curl -k or expose passwords as formal guidance.
Reject empty grep output and unrelated chassis/PSU power sensors.
Preserve raw timestamped values and units.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve the actual sensor/resource members and validate target identity.
Collect timestamped IPMI values with names, units and status through protected access.
Optionally collect the approved Redfish representation as supplemental evidence, not a replacement for the source method.
Normalize and present comparison evidence without DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve CPU sensor mapping, semantics and tolerance.
Perform or approve synchronized WebUI comparison.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partially useful for discovery only; grep is overbroad, `/Chassis/1/Power` is not portable, curl -k and command-line secrets are unsafe, and PowerControl may be chassis aggregate rather than CPU power.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a protected IPMI sensor parser against the owner-mapped CPU sensor, preserving value/unit/status/timestamp; discover any supplemental Redfish URI from service root with certificate verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original IPMI grep, UI comparison, Script and 5/0-minute values are preserved; additional controls do not replace either acceptance checkpoint.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Collect the mapped CPU sensor and synchronized WebUI value, normalize units and compare within an approved tolerance.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Project BMC exposing an authoritative CPU power metric.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Pin BMC firmware, IPMI/Redfish schema and WebUI build.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor sensor map plus Project telemetry/tolerance specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity, field mapping, freshness, units and a defensible comparison model while preserving IPMI and WebUI coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Redfish is supplemental unless approved equivalent; UI evidence is still required by the Master.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Sensor/UI mapping, sampling semantics and tolerance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Asynchronous or differently averaged readings may differ without indicating a defect.

project_override_considerations: A Project-approved Redfish or vendor telemetry API may automate collection, but equivalence to the IPMI sensor and WebUI field must be documented; otherwise it is partial evidence only.
expected_evidence: Raw IPMI sensor name/value/unit/status with timestamp
Synchronized WebUI capture and any supplemental Redfish resource
Normalized comparison, approved tolerance, no-mutation audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require a read-only CPU power value and WebUI comparison; the missing mapping/tolerance are Project readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The objective is coherent and safe to prepare. Missing sensor mapping, credentials and tolerance delay execution but do not create an irreconcilable semantic conflict.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects unqualified YES and unsafe guessed Redfish details while retaining the useful read-only collection idea.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Confirms hybrid classification and case-specific mapping/tolerance safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds the missing semantic and evidence gates beyond generic operator judgment.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Separates telemetry reading from cap enable/write/stress behavior.

review_improvement: Turns a grep-and-eyeball procedure into traceable CPU-specific, unit-aware, synchronized evidence without claiming DUT PASS.
independent_technical_reasoning: Power sensor names can include PSU input, chassis total, CPU package or derived readings. A grep hit is not enough to identify CPU current power, and WebUI values may be averaged on a different cadence. Collection is automatable, but the source explicitly requires WebUI comparison and correctness judgment, so a package plus human confirmation is the honest coverage classification.
